action.description: rename: title, or none to retitle from the first message. configure: model, effort. handoff: branch. interrupt: stops its turn and children. settle: only when the person explicitly asks; a working thread settles once done, unless it fails or needs the person. unsettle: also cancels a pending settle. snooze: until. close_preview: previewId. rename_project: name.

model.description: Id from models, or a name ("opus 5.5") on its account.

onlyIfProvisional.description: Only replace a title ace generated, never the person's.

requestId.description: Any stable id; a repeat with it runs once.

until.description: Epoch ms, or null to unmute.

x-ace-constraint: configure needs requestId and model; interrupt needs requestId; handoff needs requestId and branch; snooze needs until; close_preview needs previewId; rename_project needs name.
